'''Cristina Llovera Rossell'''{{family name footnote|lang=Catalan|Llovera|Rossell}} (born 1 October 1996 in [[Andorra la Vella]]) is an [[Andorra]]n runner.<ref>{{Cite web |url=https://www.iaaf.org/athletes/andorra/cristina-llovera-274711 |title=IAAF: Cristina LLOVERA {{!}} Profile |website=iaaf.org |access-date=2018-04-30}}</ref> She competed at the [[2012 Summer Olympics]] in the [[Athletics at the 2012 Summer Olympics – Women's 100 metres|Women's 100 metres]] where she was eliminated in the preliminary round.<ref>{{Cite news |url=https://www.olympic.org/cristina-llovera |title=Cristina LLOVERA - Olympic Athletics {{!}} Andorra |date=2016-06-25 |work=International Olympic Committee |access-date=2018-04-30 |language=en}}</ref><ref name="SR">{{cite Sports-Reference |title=Cristina Llovera |quote=Full name: Cristina Llovera Rossell}}</ref> Llovera was the youngest participant in the Athletics competition.{{Citation needed|date=April 2018}}

In 2016 an injury deprived her of repeating that experience in Rio de Janeiro's Olympic Games. Two months before the event se had a spondylosis, a small fracture in a vertebra, which left her without options.
